info.title: NOTHING Verification API
info.summary: NOTHING verification, authenticated ingestion and billing API
info.description: Deployment-neutral API contract for resolving a NOTHING identity into claims, evidence references, verification events and versioned procedures. The API does not turn structural validity into a universal trust score. Production authenticated writes use JWT access tokens and scope authorization. Authenticated billing provides a customer-scoped price catalog, invoice creation and entitlement reads; settlement itself is performed by the receive-only payment observation pipeline and PostgreSQL billing core.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Client-selected printable ASCII request key. The same key must not be reused for a different request by the same authenticated actor.

ETag.description: Opaque representation validator used with If-None-Match.

LastModified.description: Last modification time of the served representation.

ProtocolVersion.description: NOTHING protocol version used to resolve the representation.

RetryAfter.description: Number of seconds the client should wait before retrying.

WWWAuthenticate.description: Authentication challenge for the bearer credential required by write ingestion.

IngestionId.description: Stable identifier assigned to the accepted ingestion transaction.

IdempotentReplay.description: Present with value true when the response was served from the stored idempotency record.

IdentityIngestionRecord.description: Protocol identity record. Normative field validation remains schema/identity.schema.json and the runtime protocol validator.

EvidenceIngestionRecord.description: Protocol evidence record. Normative field validation remains schema/evidence.schema.json and the runtime protocol validator.

VerificationEventIngestionRecord.description: Protocol verification event. Normative field validation remains schema/verification-event.schema.json and the runtime protocol validator.

amount.description: Exact decimal amount rendered from amount_atomic and asset_decimals.

BearerAuth.description: Production path: signed OAuth 2.0 access token validated against a fixed HTTPS JWKS endpoint, with issuer, audience, expiry, token type and explicit signing-algorithm validation. The reference static-bearer mode remains for local development only.
